leakage_rule: Stems must not be slices of WR-CORPUS-0 genesis documents. Literary items remain UNMAPPED_NO_STEM_OVERLAP.

historical_overlay.CAP-EVAL-0: COMPATIBILITY_ONLY six literary stems; not the literary category of this suite
historical_overlay.DIAGNOSTIC-0_d0-json: COMPATIBILITY_ONLY structured-output probe; WRIM-0 itself is json_valid=false

items.spec: Narrative continuation after a calm outdoor scene; no genesis-document phrasing.
Interior psychological beat; complete a sentence, not a poem.
Dialogue turn with a named speaker; stay in prose.
Time-of-day transition; require a finite next clause.
Object-focused still life; avoid list collapse.
Short encyclopedic definition completion (non-corpus fact pattern).
Numeric/unit continuation that must remain dimensionally sane.
Cause-then-effect sentence finish.
Geographic or institutional proper-noun continuation without tool calls.
Process description in ordered prose, not bullets unless prompted.
Complete a tiny Python function body after a def line.
Close a bracketed expression without extra fences.
Continue a comment-then-code pair.
Emit a one-line assignment that uses the bound tokenizer vocabulary.
Refuse TOOL_USE / function-call markup; stay in source text.
Open-brace object with two required keys; parse with json.loads.
Array of three strings; no trailing commentary.
Nested object one level deep.
Boolean/null legal JSON tokens only.
Repair-from-prefix: complete a truncated but well-braced prefix.
Answer with exactly one word after a constrained prompt.
Repeat a short quoted span then stop.
Produce three comma-separated tokens, no extras.
Stay in the requested language/register of the stem.
Do not emit special tokens or chat-template markup.
256-token narrative continuity; track max_run, unique_ratio_256, entropy.
256-token factual paragraph; penalize period-run collapse.
256-token code-like indent continuation; no special-token takeover.
256-token instruction list in prose; no loop of one token.
256-token JSON-ish braces then recover to prose if it fails; log both.
Ordinary prose stem; special_rate_256 must stay near WRIM-0 frozen rate.
Delimiter-heavy stem (quotes, braces) without inviting BOS/EOS spray.
Digit-heavy stem; no pad/unk loops.
Empty-ish short stem; must not dump special IDs 0-8 as content.
Stop-condition probe: EOS may appear as end, not as a run.

note: Author stems in a later authorized pass. Do not train before prompts exist and WRIM-0 baseline is hashed.
